node-api/test_async_context/test-gcable-.reason: since Node.js 25 napi_async_init keeps the resource object alive; the script from nodejs/node main asserts the new behavior (older releases ship a version of the script that expects the resource to be collected)

node-api/test_threadsafe_function_abort/.reason: the script ships with a Node.js change in these releases; on Node.js 22 the thread finalizer runs before the queued item reaches call_js_cb, so its assertion fails

node-api/test_threadsafe_function_shutdo.reason: the script ships with a Node.js change in these releases; on Node.js 22 threads still calling napi_call_threadsafe_function during environment shutdown make the process abort

node-api/test_module_version_mismatch/te.reason: older Node.js releases crash (SIGSEGV) instead of throwing when an add-on declares an unsupported Node-API version, also with the original C add-on; the script ships with the fix in 26.11.0

js-native-api/test_cannot_run_js/test.reason: the script loads two Go addons (test_pending_exception, test_cannot_run_js) in one process; on macOS x64 napi-go supports one Go runtime per process and rejects the second with ERR_NAPI_GO_FOREIGN_RUNTIME

node-api/test_reference_by_node_api_vers.reason: the script loads two Go addons (test_reference_obj_only, test_reference_all_types) in one process; on macOS x64 napi-go supports one Go runtime per process and rejects the second with ERR_NAPI_GO_FOREIGN_RUNTIME
